title: Findings file
description: One batch of address-level facts mined from one source, and the chain of custody for each: where it came from, which parcel it names, and which PR put it on a page. See research/findings/README.md.

source_id.description: Registered id from research/SOURCES.md. Also the id a page cites.

batch.description: The unit read: a year of a paper, a volume, one report, a block range.

coverage.description: What was read, counted. A zero-finding pass still fills this in.

examined.description: How many units were read in this batch.

remaining.description: What this batch did NOT cover, named precisely enough to resume.

date.description: ISO date where known; a bare year or a phrase where not. Never invented.

kind.description: What sort of fact: building contract, fire, advertisement, sale, site history, alteration, occupancy, designation, photograph.

address_as_written.description: The source's own words. Never corrected, never normalized.

description.description: The fact, re-expressed in our own words. Never the source's sentence.

extra.description: What the record itself stated: cost, lot dimensions, cross streets, architect, contractor, form, rooms. Free-form.

label.description: What a page's Sources footer prints.

url.description: Stable public URL for the exact item, where one exists.

corpus_path.description: Path under research/corpora/ the text came from.

locator.description: Page, section, issue or seq — precise enough to re-find.

raw.description: Evidence for the resolver and auditor. Never reaches a page.

text.description: Shortest span that justifies the extraction.

note.description: Why this span is not what the source literally says: a name redacted out of it, or a span entered by hand because the extractor could not reach it. `text` is the audit trail, so an auditor has to be told where it was altered and whether re-running the tool would undo that.

conflict.description: Set when this contradicts the assessor or another source. Recorded, never adjudicated.

path.description: Site path the fact belongs on, e.g. /san-francisco/mission/alabama-street/1311/

method.description: What was checked. The audit trail: cross streets, lot area, EAS join.

note.description: Required in spirit for unresolved/rejected: why.

by_hand.description: Set when a reader resolved this entry by hand. resolve_eas.py apply leaves it alone instead of recomputing it.

note.description: Why this entry says what it says: a correction made after the fact, or the reason its wording differs from what shipped. findings/README.md asks for one whenever an entry is edited after it was written.
